# Write-free e2e: purity snapshot — write-free commands create no destination files.

# Sentinel starts with marker only.
snapshot_tree sentinel sentinel_before.txt

# version / catalog — embedded only; no project writes.
exec foundry version
exec foundry version --output json
exec foundry catalog list
exec foundry catalog show core
exec foundry catalog show cli --output json

# validate + plan with dest under $WORK/out (Lstat observation only).
mkdir out
snapshot_tree out out_before.txt
exec foundry validate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./out/minimal-cli
stdout 'validate: ok'
exec foundry plan --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./out/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
! exists out/minimal-cli
assert_tree_unchanged out out_before.txt

# generate pure-path refusal (basename≠name) still pure under out/ and sentinel/.
! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./out/from-generate
! exists out/from-generate
assert_tree_unchanged out out_before.txt

! exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest ./sentinel/from-generate
! exists sentinel/from-generate
assert_tree_unchanged sentinel sentinel_before.txt

list_tree out
list_tree sentinel
